newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index sheds 1.51 percent.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index sheds 1.51 percent.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was down 1.28 points, or 1.51 percent, at 83.25 on Tuesday after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index provisionally fell 2.95 points to 3,795.17. The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market fell to 15.41 percent from 17.02 percent on Monday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
